summary: Adds beta cross-device sync for dose history using your gTimer sync server.

new_features: Added beta cross-device dose history sync using your own gTimer sync server.
minor_improvements: Added Settings controls for sync server URL, private sync token, sync status, and manual Sync Now.
Updated the Android and Windows parity plan to use the custom sync API as the shared future direction.
bug_fixes: Deleted dose records are now hidden locally while preserving sync tombstones for other devices.
